"""Suppressed function-tier carrier two."""


def gold_beta_first(rows: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    seen = set()
    out = []
    index = 0
    limit = len(rows)
    while index < limit:
        key = rows[index].strip()
        index = index + 1
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append(key)
    out.sort()
    return out


def gold_beta_second(rows: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    seen = set()
    out = []
    index = 0
    limit = len(rows)
    while index < limit:
        key = rows[index].strip()
        index = index + 1
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append(key)
    out.sort()
    return out
